fact.subject: Mistral AI
fact.object: Studio managed agents, apps and workflow features

evidence.quote: Today, we’re expanding Studio with managed agents and apps, alongside new capabilities for workflows, enterprise context, agent observability and evaluations.
Deploy them wherever you choose: in the cloud, in your own VPC, on-premises or across a combination of environments.

title: Le Chonk brings the brains. Studio puts it to work.
displayTitle: Mistral扩展Studio：托管Agent与企业流程接入并进
summary: Mistral在Studio新增托管Agent和应用，并扩展工作流、企业上下文、可观测性和评估能力；可在云、私有VPC或本地部署。
investorNote: 企业代理竞争正从单一模型推理转向数据权限、部署可控和可观测的工作流产品。
narrative: Mistral宣布扩展Studio的托管Agent、应用、工作流和评估功能，同时强调云、私有VPC及本地部署选择。对企业客户，模型能力只是起点，能否在现有权限和流程内稳定运行才决定试点转生产。

eventRelation.reason: 本次为Studio平台新增功能，非旧模型发布的重复报道。
